notes.title: Claire de Lune Launch sale
notes.notes:
[b]Claire de Lune is launched![/b]

To celebrate the launch of our new game Claire de Lune, we decided to have a big Immortal Empire sale. Any radiance purchase gives 50% more than usual. This discount will last for a limited time. 

Check out the trailer for Claire de Lune below:

[previewyoutube=myuyaAMpLY0;full][/previewyoutube]

The game can be found on the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/717110/Claire_de_Lune/]Steam Storefront[/url].

Happy Gaming,
Tactic Studios

notes.title: Patch 2.3.0 released!
notes.notes:
[b]Latest patch for Immortal Empire offers the following features:[/b]
[list]
    [*]Treant immortal has had many abilities altered, improved, including a replacement ultimate.
    [*]You can now connect to gauntlet games in progress, making it possible to find replacement players or reconnect after a disconnection.
    [*]Various minor bug fixes
    [*]Currency adjustments for various regions to fit more in line with current values (prices generally cheaper in most regions)
[/list]

Come check out the revamped Treant!

notes.title: Gambling and Stash!
notes.notes:
New version of Immortal Empire 2.2.0 is focused on improving the store. 

This update includes: 
[list]
[*]You can now gamble gold for random divine and mythical items
[*]You now have an account-wide stash for holding gold, crystals, and items
[*]You can now buyback recently sold items to the store to prevent accidental sales
[*]Level 51-60 radiance item packs are now cheaper
[*]Radiance item purchases (including charms, runes) now only spawn items of divine or greater value.
[/list]

Full patch notes can be found at our [url=http://tacticstudios.com/empire/changelog.shtml]website[/url]

Note: If you bought any of the item, charm, or runes with radiance within the last 15 days, please contact gamesupport@tacticstudios.com with your immortal name and date of purchase (along with any real-money transaction information if relevant) and we will 100% refund your purchase.

notes.title: 2nd Official Tournament - Campaign Speedruns
notes.notes:
2nd official tournament since we launched on Steam will be a set of campaign speedruns.  

Enjoy Immortal Empire, want to be competitive but don't fancy PvP? No problem! Play in a campaign speedrun. All players simultaneously try to clear a given campaign level and whoever finishes first wins!

[list]
[*][b]Date and Time:[/b] 1:00pm EST February 21st, 2016
[*][b]Characters:[/b] All immortals at any level are permitted. Higher level players will compete on higher difficulties, and there will be a prize for winners at each difficulty level attempted.
[*][b]Duration:[/b] Speedrun tournaments usually last 1-2 hours with multiple speedruns to try.
[*][b]Prizes:[/b] Runes will be awarded to the winners and runner ups of each speedrun.
[/list]

Join chat channel "Tournament" using the command "/join tournament" when in public chat. Please arrive 10 minutes early to ensure you are ready to start the speedrun on time.

notes.title: Deathmatch and 4v4 is here!
notes.notes:
Version 2.1.0 has a ton of improvements geared towards enhancing the PvP experience inside Immortal Empire.  

This update includes:
[list]
[*]Deathmatch PvP mode including a new map
[*]Up to 4v4 for tower control and deathmatch allowing primary immortals only
[*]Loads of improvements for spectators to better observe PvP games.
[*]A huge slew of balance changes to facilitate better PvP matches.
[*]Various other bug fixes both large and small.
[/list]

Full patch notes can be found at our [url=http://tacticstudios.com/empire/changelog.shtml]website[/url].

Come log on and check out the new deathmatch and 4v4 modes!
